# Pau Hana Surf Supply

&gt; Pau Hana Surf Supply is a California-based stand-up paddleboard (SUP) manufacturer founded in 2006. We design award-winning inflatable and hardboard paddleboards for every skill level — from beginner-friendly all-arounders to expedition touring boards and surf SUPs. Our boards are sold direct and through retail partners including REI and L.L.Bean. "Pau Hana" is Hawaiian for "finished work" — the moment you trade the daily grind for time on the water.

Website: https://pauhanasurfco.com

## Paddleboards — By Activity

- [All-Around Paddle Boards](https://pauhanasurfco.com/collections/all-around-paddle-boards): Stable, versatile boards for beginners and families — flatwater, light surf, and everyday paddling
- [Touring &amp; Distance](https://pauhanasurfco.com/collections/touring-expedition-paddle-boards): Longer, faster boards built for multi-mile paddles, day trips, and multi-day expeditions
- [Surfing &amp; Waves](https://pauhanasurfco.com/collections/surf-paddle-boards): Shorter, maneuverable SUPs designed for wave riding and performance surfing
- [Fishing &amp; Adventure](https://pauhanasurfco.com/collections/fishing-paddle-boards): Wide, stable platforms with SeaMount accessory systems for rod holders, coolers, and gear
- [Fitness &amp; Yoga](https://pauhanasurfco.com/collections/yoga-paddle-boards): Extra-wide boards with full-length deck pads for on-water yoga, HIIT, and fitness paddling
- [Racing &amp; Performance](https://pauhanasurfco.com/collections/racing-performance-paddleboards): Narrow, displacement-hull boards for competitive paddling and fitness training

## Paddleboards — By Type

- [Hard Paddle Boards](https://pauhanasurfco.com/collections/solid-paddleboards): Rigid boards in EPS/epoxy, VFT (Vacuum Formed Technology), and Ricochet construction for maximum performance and durability
- [Inflatable Paddle Boards](https://pauhanasurfco.com/collections/inflatable-paddle-boards): Portable, travel-friendly iSUPs using TPU and military-grade PVC construction — pack down to backpack size

## Flagship &amp; Popular Models

- [Stowaway Lite '25](https://pauhanasurfco.com/products/110-big-ez-stowaway): Award-winning 11' travel inflatable SUP weighing only 18.7 lbs — our lightest all-around board, $999
- [Big EZ Hawaiian](https://pauhanasurfco.com/products/11-0-big-ez-hawaiian): Classic 11' beginner-friendly all-around hardboard with wide stable platform, $1,299
- [Oahu](https://pauhanasurfco.com/products/100-oahu): 10' recreational hardboard for paddlers with some experience, versatile for flatwater and light surf, $1,299
- [Malibu Classic](https://pauhanasurfco.com/products/106-malibu-classic-paddleboard): 10'6" wide, stable beginner board with durable ABS/foam construction, $999
- [Endurance XL](https://pauhanasurfco.com/products/12-0-endurance-xl): 12' expedition touring board designed for multi-day trips with bivy camping capability
- [Big EZ Angler](https://pauhanasurfco.com/products/big-ez-angler): 11' fishing SUP with Ricochet shell and full SeaMount accessory system
- [Moon Mist](https://pauhanasurfco.com/products/10-0-moon-mist): 10' yoga and fitness SUP with soft deck pad — doubles as a surf SUP
- [Solo SUP™](https://pauhanasurfco.com/products/1010-solo-backcountry): 10'10" ultracompact inflatable that packs to sleeping-bag size — ideal for backcountry and travel, $599
- [Carve](https://pauhanasurfco.com/products/86-carve-surf-paddle-board): 8'6" surf-specific SUP for wave riding and performance surfing
- [Diablo Air](https://pauhanasurfco.com/products/96-diablo-air-1): 8'6" inflatable whitewater SUP built for rivers and rapids

## Gear &amp; Accessories

- [SUP Paddles](https://pauhanasurfco.com/collections/paddles): Adjustable and fixed-length paddles in carbon, fiberglass, and aluminum
- [Accessories](https://pauhanasurfco.com/collections/accessories): SeaMount-compatible rod holders, cup holders, paddle clips, D-rings, leashes, and deck bags
- [Apparel](https://pauhanasurfco.com/collections/apparel): Branded tees, hats, and water-ready clothing
- [Swimwear](https://pauhanasurfco.com/collections/swimwear): Performance swimwear for paddlers
